en: A vintage, color-illustrated Christmas postcard showing a snowy evening scene in a historic European city square. Old multi-story buildings with lit windows surround a central fountain or monument. In the foreground stands an angelic child figure holding a small decorated Christmas tree and a basket. In the background on a hill rises a clock-tower-like structure and fortifications under a full moon. Gold-colored German text appears at the top of the image.
